> NEXORA is a compact PC control deck with a small OLED touchscreen and a modern, futuristic design. It makes everyday PC tasks easier by putting your favorite shortcuts and controls all in one place. It features 9 customizable shortcut buttons that let you open apps, launch games, run macros, access folders, and perform quick actions on your PC with a single tap. You can set up each button to do whatever works best for you. The OLED screen gives you quick access to your shortcuts and different control panels. You can also use it to manage things like system volume, microphone settings, and other useful PC functions. NEXORA also includes a dedicated Spotify section, letting you play or pause music, skip tracks, and control your playback without having to switch windows. There's also an optional speaker output feature that lets you play Spotify audio through a connected speaker. The idea behind NEXORA is simple: make your PC easier to control, keep your favorite tools close at hand, and give you a setup that looks as good as it works.
